title: Logging & alerts
subtitle: Alert webhooks, request content, retention, and log archiving.
retentionHint: 0 keeps request logs indefinitely. Spend and audit use their own retention.
spendRetentionHint: 0 keeps finance spend events indefinitely, even if request logs expire.
auditRetentionHint: 0 keeps the console audit trail indefinitely.
objectRetentionHint: Stored responses, batches, batch results, and videos. 0 keeps them indefinitely; running batches are never deleted.
fileRetentionHint: Files uploaded through /v1/files. 0 keeps them indefinitely.
webhookSecretState: {set, select, true {A secret is stored. Enter a new one to replace it.} other {No secret stored}}
archive: Archive request logs to object storage
archiveHint: {ready, select, true {Each request log is also written as JSON under logs/requests/ in the configured bucket.} other {Configure object storage in Admin settings first.}}
alertsHint: Each webhook receives only the events selected for it. With a signing secret, requests carry X-LLMHub-Timestamp and X-LLMHub-Signature: sha256=HMAC(secret, timestamp.body).
noWebhooks: No webhooks yet. Alerts are not delivered.
eventLabel: {event, select, upstream_exhaustion {Upstream exhaustion} budget_threshold {Budget threshold} provider_models_changed {Provider models changed} other {Event}}
eventHint: {event, select, upstream_exhaustion {No healthy deployment answered, or the upstream returned 5xx or 429.} budget_threshold {A key, team, organization, or project crossed a budget alert threshold.} provider_models_changed {The hourly sync found added or removed provider models.} other {}}
contentSubtitle: Prompts and responses stored with each request log.
contentHint: Turn it off for a single person in Users or for a single key in its key settings. While PII redaction is active, stored content is masked and every log shows the entities it found.
contentRetentionHint: 0 keeps content as long as the request log. A lower value removes prompts and responses earlier and keeps the metadata.
